name: Dune knotweed
desc: Dune knotweed (Polygonum paronychia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Polygonum paronychia is a species of flowering plant in the knotweed family known by the common names dune knotweed, black knotweed, and beach knotweed.
